{{Quote|I know where the Heralds are headquartered, but they won't give up any information willingly.|[[Senya Tirall]]|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
The '''Herald Stronghold''' was located in [[District 1327|Breaktown]] on [[Zakuul]]. It was the headquarters of the [[Heralds of Zildrog]]. During the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] and [[Senya Tirall]] fought the Heralds in their stronghold while looking for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />
{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Herald Stronghold appears during "Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
